title: Android: LightmapGI with big scenes crashes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.beta5

### System information

Android (14/15)

### Issue description

Game crashes when loading a "big" scene that uses a LightmapGI node with baked lighting.
Was able to reproduce this on a 300 sqm scene.
Problem doesn't seem to be related to the lightmap texture memory footprint, as even a texture as small as 800kb (vram compressed) causes the crash.

Was able to reproduce this on Vulkan 1.3 devices (Pixel 9a w/ Android 15 and Xiaomi Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G w/ Android 15).
Vulkan 1.1 devices do not seem to suffer from this problem (Tested on Xiaomi mi 11i w/ Android 15 and Oneplus 8T w/ Android 14)

Any idea/workaround?

Here's the crashlog presented on the Pixel 9a with the attached MRP

### Steps to reproduce

With the attached MRP running the game on an Android device is enough.
Otherwise:
- Set up a big/wide scene (a few hundred square meters should be enough)
- Make sure to have UV2 unwrapped for the scene
- Bake LightmapGI, any texel scale
- Run the game on Android

[lightmap_crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21950733/lightmap_crash.zip)
